subject.title: fix #95895: [Security]: GEMINI_API_KEY written as a plaintext literal in the generated systemd service unit

question: Should OpenClaw accept this narrowed policy that makes selected Google/Gemini auth-profile env refs file-backed in generated systemd service environments while leaving other auth-profile env refs unchanged?
rationale: The code path is source-backed and the proof exercises the staging boundary, but CI cannot decide the intended credential-delivery/security boundary or whether the allowlist should instead become a generic auth-profile policy.

options.title: Accept Narrow File-Backed Policy
options.body: Merge after current-head gates remain green if maintainers agree the existing EnvironmentFile contract is the right boundary for these Google/Gemini auth-profile keys.

options.title: Broaden Auth-Profile Policy
options.body: Ask for a revision if the desired contract is to route all safe auth-profile env refs, or all documented Google/Gemini key shapes, through a common policy.

options.title: Keep Auth Profiles Separate
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want the linked security issue limited to config SecretRefs and prefer separate auth-profile work later.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow File-Backed Policy
recommendation.body: Merge after current-head gates remain green if maintainers agree the existing EnvironmentFile contract is the right boundary for these Google/Gemini auth-profile keys.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current-main config SecretRef repair for the same issue and are the best evidenced maintainer-side routing candidate from live PR history.
